component.name: Postilla
component.summary: Markdown notes for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: Postilla is a markdown note taking editor for the COSMIC™ desktop: a vault of notes, a live preview, and the tools you expect from a notes app, all offline.

ul.li: Editor only, split and preview only layouts, plus a zen mode
Outline of the current note and full text search across the vault
Autosave, cut/copy/paste everywhere, right click editing menu
Customizable syntax highlighting: TextMate themes, COSMIC Terminal color schemes and simple RON themes
Frosted glass window with adjustable opacity and background color
Export to PDF (offline, rendered with Typst) and HTML
Typst math and Mermaid diagrams inside code blocks

description.p: Postilla is a fork of Cedilla by Alex Marín (mariinkys), released under the GPL-3.0. It is developed with libcosmic for the COSMIC™ desktop, and issues may occur on other platforms.

screenshot.caption: Typst math and Mermaid diagrams in the preview
Full text search across the vault

description.p: Reload themes and importing a theme update the window background right away
With "Use highlighter theme colors" on, the editor and preview follow the window opacity
With "Use highlighter theme colors" on, the preview follows the highlighter theme: background, text, Typst math and links
First Postilla release, forked from Cedilla 0.1.13
Cut, copy, paste and select all in the Edit menu and a right click menu on the editor
Editor only, split and preview only layouts and a zen mode
Customizable syntax highlighting themes: tmTheme, COSMIC Terminal color schemes and RON themes
Frosted glass window effect, window opacity and background color settings
Document outline, search across the vault, autosave and HTML export
Offline PDF export rendered with Typst
Strikethrough, quote, table and date/time formatting, word count and reading time
Use any existing folder as the vault
